Lemma 3.1 (Saunders and Moran 1978) gives a star-order characterization for an arbitrary parametric family {Fa : a > 0} — an ordering result stated for a fully general class, excluded by spec scope; the paper's family-specific star-order applications are Theorems 3.10/3.11, captured separately.

records.quote: Theorem 3.1. Let Xi ~ EW(α, λi, k) (i = 1, ..., n) and Yi ~ EW(α, µi, k) (i = 1, ..., n) have their associated Archimedean survival copulas to be with generators ψ1 and ψ2, respectively. Further, suppose ϕ2 ∘ ψ1 is super-additive and ψ1 is log-concave. Then, for 0 < α ≤ 1, we have (log λ1, ..., log λn) ⪰w (log µ1, ..., log µn) ⇒ Y1:n ⪰st X1:n.

Then, if (α + ᾱt) ln(t/(α + ᾱt)) [α + 2ᾱt − (α + ᾱt)tϕ''(1 − t)/ϕ'(1 − t)] is increasing with respect to t ∈ [0, 1] and 0 < k ≤ 1, we have (λ1 − λ2)(µ1 − µ2) ≥ 0 and λ2:2/λ1:2 ≥ µ2:2/µ1:2 ⇒ Yn:n ≤* Xn:n, where p + q = n.

records.quote: Theorem 3.11. Let Xi ~ EW(α, λ1, k) (i = 1, ..., p) and Xj ~ EW(α, λ2, k) (j = p + 1, ..., n), and Yi ~ EW(α, µ1, k) (i = 1, ..., p) and Yj ~ EW(α, µ2, k) (j = p + 1, ..., n) be variables with a common Archimedean survival copula having generator ψ.
